AI_AGENTS.DESCRIPTION: This is the page where you can revisit the AI agents you created earlier. Feel free to make changes and create as many AI agents as you want anytime!
AI_AGENTS.NO_RESULTS: No AI agents match your search.

CREATE.TITLE: Create AI agent
CREATE.DESCRIPTION: Give your AI agent a name. You can set up its behavior and settings next.
CREATE.ERROR: Could not create the AI agent. Please try again.

DUPLICATE.ERROR: Could not duplicate the AI agent. Please try again.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete {name}?
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: This permanently removes the AI agent and its settings. This cannot be undone.
DELETE.ERROR: Could not delete the AI agent. Please try again.

DETAIL.NOT_FOUND: This AI agent does not exist or was deleted.

BEHAVIOR.TITLE: AI Agent Behavior
BEHAVIOR.DESCRIPTION: This is the AI Prompt that defines the AI's speaking style and identity.
BEHAVIOR.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. You are the customer service of our store. Answer briefly and kindly.

WELCOME_MESSAGE.TITLE: Welcome Message
WELCOME_MESSAGE.DESCRIPTION: The first message the AI will send to the user.
WELCOME_MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Hi! I am the virtual assistant. How can I help you today?

TRANSFER_CONDITIONS.TITLE: Agent Transfer Conditions
TRANSFER_CONDITIONS.DESCRIPTION: Define conditions that trigger the AI to transfer the chat to a human agent. Chat status will become Pending and appear in the Assigned
TRANSFER_CONDITIONS.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Transfer when the customer asks to talk to a person or wants to complain.

STOP_AI_AFTER_HANDOFF.TITLE: Stop AI after Handoff
STOP_AI_AFTER_HANDOFF.DESCRIPTION: Stop the AI from sending messages after the chat status changes to Pending.

SILENT_HANDOFF.TITLE: Silent Agent Handoff
SILENT_HANDOFF.DESCRIPTION: AI silently transfers the conversation to an agent with no further AI replies.

PENDING_MESSAGES.TITLE: Pending status messages
PENDING_MESSAGES.DESCRIPTION: Set messages customers receive while waiting for handoff

ASSIGNED.TITLE: Pending - assigned message
ASSIGNED.DESCRIPTION: Sent when Stop AI after Handoff is on and a pending chat already has an assigned agent.
ASSIGNED.PLACEHOLDER: Enter message for pending assigned conversations

UNASSIGNED.TITLE: Pending - unassigned message
UNASSIGNED.DESCRIPTION: Sent when Stop AI after Handoff is on and no agent is assigned yet.
UNASSIGNED.PLACEHOLDER: Enter message for pending unassigned conversations

AI_ACTIONS.TITLE: AI Actions
AI_ACTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Configure labels that AI can use automatically

LABELS.TITLE: Change Conversation Label
LABELS.DESCRIPTION: Select labels that AI is allowed to use for tagging conversations automatically.

LABEL_CONDITIONS.TITLE: Label Conditions
LABEL_CONDITIONS.DESCRIPTION: Instructions for when AI should apply specific labels. Example: "Apply label Purchased when customer confirms a purchase"
LABEL_CONDITIONS.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Apply label booking when the customer has filled in the order format.

ADDITIONAL_SETTINGS.TITLE: Additional Settings
ADDITIONAL_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Fine-tune memory, timing, and limits of the AI

HISTORY_LIMIT.TITLE: AI History Limit
HISTORY_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: The number of messages the AI will remember.

READ_FILE_LIMIT.TITLE: AI Read File Limit
READ_FILE_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: The number of recent messages whose file attachments the AI will read.

CONTEXT_LIMIT.TITLE: AI Context Limit
CONTEXT_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: AI depth level for reading knowledge sources. Increase this if you have more knowledge entries.

TEMPERATURE.TITLE: AI Temperature
TEMPERATURE.DESCRIPTION: The creativity level of the AI when responding to user messages.

MESSAGE_AWAIT.TITLE: Message Await
MESSAGE_AWAIT.DESCRIPTION: Delay time before the AI responds to a user message, in seconds.

MESSAGE_LIMIT.TITLE: AI Message Limit
MESSAGE_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: Limit on the number of AI messages per conversation session. Resets when the chat is resolved.

WATCHER.TITLE: Watcher
WATCHER.DESCRIPTION: Monitors AI responses to ensure important functions are executed.

TIMEZONE.TITLE: Timezone
TIMEZONE.DESCRIPTION: Select the timezone for the AI.

SESSION_ONLY_MEMORY.TITLE: Session-Only Memory
SESSION_ONLY_MEMORY.DESCRIPTION: When enabled, AI will start conversation without remembering previous session(s)

IGNORE_TEAM_HANDOFF.TITLE: Ignore Team Handoff
IGNORE_TEAM_HANDOFF.DESCRIPTION: The AI will not consider team assignment when handing off to a human agent.

GENERAL.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the AI settings. Please try again.
